title: What if dinosaurs never went extinct

lines.text: What if the asteroid that killed the dinosaurs had missed?
lines.note: Chicxulub impact · about 66 million years ago

lines.text: You would never have been born.
Back then, our ancestors were tiny, shrew-sized animals, hiding from dinosaurs.
lines.note: Most mammals were small · a few reached badger size

lines.text: In real life, the asteroid cleared the planet, and mammals finally got big.
But if it missed, the dinosaurs keep the planet. And we probably stay tiny.
Here's the twist. Some dinosaurs were already getting smarter.
lines.note: Troodon · a big brain for its body size

lines.text: In 1982, a paleontologist imagined where that could lead.
A big-brained dinosaur that walks upright, like us. The Dinosauroid.
lines.note: A thought experiment · many scientists call it too human

lines.text: So right now, something might still be scrolling past this video.
